name: rhongomiant-spellshroud-holds-without-mordred-champion
notes: Rhongomiant, Grove's Spire (clS3E0HrZL, EXALTED/NORM WARRIOR REGALIA/WEAPON): "Spellshroud (Objects with spellshroud can't be targeted by spells.)" -- the first, unconditional keyword; only its two [Mordred Bonus] clauses are conditional. Condition boundary: Spellshroud is not a [Mordred Bonus]. With player 1's champion patched to Tristan, Shadowdancer (not a Mordred) the opposing Fracturize still finds no legal target.

rulesClauses: Spellshroud: objects with spellshroud can't be targeted by spells.
The Spellshroud is unconditional; only the two later clauses are [Mordred Bonus].

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Rhongomiant's printed Spellshroud was not implemented: a spell could target it. HasSpellshroud() (Custom/GameLogic.php) recognised printed Spellshroud only through a hard-coded card-ID list and HasKeyword_Spellshroud(), which is never generated (function_exists is false), and clS3E0HrZL was in neither, so FilterSpellshroudTargets() kept Rhongomiant in the target list. Evidence on HEAD a1f72a1c (pinned by the old rhongomiant-spellshroud-spell-can-still-target-it fixture, now removed): player 2's Fracturize target prompt was 'MZCHOOSE:theirField-1' (player 1's Rhongomiant) and choosing it replaced the weapon with a Cleric Fractal phantasia override. Fix: HasSpellshroud() returns true for clS3E0HrZL (after the HasNoAbilities / NO_SPELLSHROUD gates). Break/restore: reverting Custom/GameLogic.php to HEAD~1 fails opponent-spell-finds-no-target (step 6: target prompt still pending), opponent-spell-offered-only-other-weapon (step 7: Rhongomiant answer unexpectedly succeeded) and own-spell-cannot-target-it (step 4 same) and holds-without-mordred-champion (step 6 prompt pending); the non-targeting and lost-abilities controls pass either way (lost-abilities was mutation-checked: moving the Rhongomiant clause above the HasNoAbilities gate fails it).
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php HasSpellshroud() (no entry for clS3E0HrZL; no generated HasKeyword_Spellshroud table)
